TABBEDJOURNALS.Title: Tabbed Journals
TABBEDJOURNALS.PopupBlocked: Your browser blocked the pop-out window. Please allow pop-ups for this site.
TABBEDJOURNALS.SettingEnableInterceptHint: When enabled, opening a Journal Entry (from the sidebar, a link, or a scene note) adds it as a tab in the shared Tabbed Journals window instead of opening its own popup window.
TABBEDJOURNALS.SettingRestoreOnLoadHint: When enabled, the Tabbed Journals window reopens with the same journals you had open last session.
